nom: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Serum

avis.texte: I've been using this product for about two weeks now and have really been enjoying it so far! It feels very hydrating and leaves my skin looking fresh after I apply it. It absorbs into skin quickly and doesn't leave any kind of tacky feeling.
Hydrates and softens your skin, use 2 pumps at night for extra soft skin in the am.
Ever since i started using this, my skin has felt more refreshed
Really enjoy this serum. I use it in days I am particularly dry or flaking from treatments. It absorbs nicely and doesn't leave a sticky feeling.
I have combination skin and hate the feel of heavy greasy moisturizer. This serum is so light and soothing. I may layer with moisturizer in the winter but for now this is all I need.

The serum's texture is not at all tacky on the skin; it just absorbs right away. The hydration this serum provides lasts all day, which says a lot as I have dry skin (I also use the birch moisturizer, which I assume has an additional effect, haha) besides hydration i find that it also gives a brightening look to the color of my skin. Will be repurchasing!
Makes me skin feel so soft and hydrated, it also works beautifully under moisturizers and makeup.
This makes my skin so moisturized and smooth. My makeup stays on better too
Light and hydrating product. Great for a sensitive skin. Have been using for a week and could see great result on my skin.

i have absolutely loved adding this serum to my daily routine, it's so smooth. it's helped my skin be glossy and i'm retaining more of my skins natural plumpnes. i'm also a fan of the fact that any fragrance is natural and really mild
Kept my skin so incredibly soft. Absorbs quickly but still hydrating enough for the dry winter months

Ordered this to try and not sure yet of its benefits quite yet... Upon initial use, consistency seems more watery than other serums I've used, but appreciate that it doesn't have any heavy fragrance and soaks into my skin.
It has a cooling fresh feeling, does not make face greasy or oily. 💗

avis.titre: Birch serum my new must have
avis.texte: I have aging,mature, sensitive skin with the tendency to rosacea. I love light blue milky color. It's not sticky. I can tell that the serum is working because my skin looks slightly red. It's just beginning of the new journey.
Absolutely love the texture and how my skin feels soft after usage. Very hydrating and nourishing.

So I love the birch sunscreen and moisturizer I decided to try this when I saw its on sale. So far other than hydrating my skin I dont see anything else. I wouldnt pay full price for it but on sale I wouldnt mind

Its a good hydrating serum but Im not wowd by it. I prefer the Isntree hyaluronic acid essence over this. The bottle is basic chubby glass that makes the plastic pump feel a little cheap in comparison.
Feels very hydrating and has a nice blue color and watery gel consistency
Nice light serum, texture feels nice on skin, absorbs quickly.
I purchased this because I loved the moisturizer. This serum felt no different from a different hydrating serum I used. I will just go back to what I used to use
